extracted.name: Midori sour
extracted.description: Stir up this springtime cocktail with Midori (or other melon liqueur) blended with vodka, soda water and freshly squeezed lime and lemon juice
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp freshly squeezed lime juice plus a twist of peel to garnish
instruction_lines: Fill a tumbler with ice, then pour in the Midori, vodka and citrus juices. Stir, then top up with soda water to taste. Garnish with a lime peel twist, then serve.
